---
name: Feature Request / Architecture Feedback
about: Suggest an idea or give architectural feedback for the BenoStreamDB Developer Preview
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "discussion"]
assignees: ''

---

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing (e.g. *I want to query Iceberg Puffin secondary indexes directly from Spark/Trino...*).

### Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, proposed API ergonomics, or architectural preference.

### Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

### Scope & Context
- [ ] Core Engine / Iceberg Puffin secondary index
- [ ] Vector Search (HNSW / Quantization)
- [ ] Graph Analytics (CSR / HippoRAG)
- [ ] SQL Engine / DataFusion pushdown
- [ ] Connectors (Python, Spark, Trino, Arrow Flight SQL)
- [ ] Documentation / Examples / Quickstart
